name: subagent
description: Spawn and manage sub-agents that run on the same model and context window as you, with the same tools. Sub-agents can communicate with each other and with you via a shared message bus. Actions: spawn (create one, needs task), run (run ONE for N tool-rounds, needs agent_id+rounds), run_all (run MANY in PARALLEL via threads, needs agent_ids+rounds), send (post a message to the bus, needs agent_id+message, optional to), read (read bus messages for an agent, needs agent_id), status (peek at an agent's state, needs agent_id), list (list active sub-agents), kill (remove one, needs agent_id), clear (clear the bus).

action.description: One of: spawn, run, run_all, send, read, status, list, kill, clear.

task.description: The task to give a new sub-agent (used with action=spawn).

name.description: Optional friendly name for a new sub-agent (used with action=spawn).

agent_id.description: A single sub-agent id (used with run/send/read/status/kill). For send/read, omit to act as 'main'.

agent_ids.description: Comma-separated list of sub-agent ids to run in PARALLEL (used with action=run_all), e.g. 'agent_1_x,agent_2_y'.

rounds.description: Max tool-rounds to run a sub-agent (used with run/run_all, default 10).

message.description: Message text to post to the bus (used with action=send).

to.description: Recipient on the bus: 'all' to broadcast, or a specific agent_id (used with action=send, default 'all').
